items.html: Now, the Kamatz indicates the Keter, as is known, and the Keter is Taamim; and the Patach indicates Hochma, and they are the Nekudot. Therefore these two Nekudot are called Kamatz and Patach, for they indicate the aforementioned matter. And it is this: that as long as only the Taamim of SAG had come out, which are the discernment of the lights of AHP, the lights were still sealed and closed [Kemutzim]. And when the discernment of the Nekudot came, which are Hochma, which is Patach, and which is the discernment of the eye, as above, then they were opened, in the opening of the eyes, as mentioned in the Tikkunim; and this is the matter of the vowel Patach [opening]. But at first, in the discernment of the Taamim, which are Keter, it is Kamatz, for the lights were closed and sealed.
